fusions.name: Trailing Pennant
fusions.desc: Sweeps the pennant trailing behind you through a cone 3.5 tiles ahead, dealing 4 damage to everything in it. Its damage rises 8% for every 100 paces you have covered since you last used it (max 40%).

fusions.name: Kite Stoop
fusions.desc: Drops on an enemy up to 8 tiles away from a cloth kite for 26 damage, up to 2 times as much at full reach. It is always a critical hit.

fusions.name: Billowing Glide
fusions.desc: Glides you 2 tiles on your cloak, then raises your movement speed by 30% and your dodge chance by 10% for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Wind-Filled Cloak
fusions.desc: Every few paces you cover, your cloak fills and you gain a shield worth 10% of your maximum health for 4 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
